title: Gravity Agent Monitor
subtitle: Live Antigravity Desktop Sidebar Replica, Trajectory & AgentAPI Bridge
description: Real-time multi-workstation telemetry, collapsible thought/tool groups, and live 2-way prompt dispatch across HTTPS Tunnel & LAN.
tagline: Real-Time Multi-Workstation Antigravity Telemetry, Trajectory Reader & Live 2-Way AgentAPI Dispatch

quickstart.detail: Sign into RollupOS as Admin and launch Gravity Agent Monitor. The app automatically unlocks via your Admin session and connects to your primary LAN sidecar (`192.168.86.47:8765`) or Tailscale mesh node.

Check the live status indicators on every active desktop conversation: spinning rings indicate active tool execution, bouncing badges signal unread completions, and amber alerts highlight steps awaiting user approval.

Tap any conversation card on the Pulse tab to jump into Trajectory view—read full user/agent messages, expand collapsible reasoning/tool blocks, and preview generated Markdown artifacts in the slide-up sheet.

quickstart.step: Reply or Launch New Tasks Remotely
quickstart.detail: Type directly into the bottom composer inside Trajectory view to reply to a live session, or open the Ops & Launcher tab (`⚙️ Nodes`) to start a brand-new conversation in any project workspace with 1-tap Skill injection.

navigation_map.purpose: Mirrors your desktop Antigravity conversation list across active PCs with unread/running status badges and Auxiliary Overview rollup.
Full chronological transcript viewer with tool-call inspection, artifact preview modal, and live 2-way reply bar.
Browse recent Markdown plans, reports, and generated workspace deliverables without remoting into your PC.
CPU/RAM host vitals, Multi-PC 'Follow-Me' fleet configuration, Keep-Awake toggle, and new project/skill task dispatcher.

deep_dive_features.title: Multi-PC 'Follow-Me' Dynamic Fleet
deep_dive_features.body: Add both your Home PC and Office PC (via LAN IP or `100.x.y.z` Tailscale IP) under Ops & Launcher. Gravity polls all configured nodes in parallel and automatically highlights whichever workstation is actively executing turns.

deep_dive_features.title: Direct 2-Way AgentAPI Prompt & Skill Dispatch
deep_dive_features.body: Uses your workstation's authenticated `X-Gravity-Token` header to dispatch replies into an existing conversation or spin up a new chat scoped to any registered project (`FF_2026`, `Div2`, `CSC Skills`, etc.) with optional pre-populated skill prompts.

deep_dive_features.title: Coffee / WakeLock Mode for Unattended Builds
deep_dive_features.body: Tap `☕ Toggle Keep-Awake` in Ops & Launcher to hold an Android screen WakeLock while monitoring long `/goal` builds or deployments.

pro_tips: When away from home Wi-Fi, paste your Tailscale IP (`http://100.x.y.z:8765`) in Ops -> Multi-PC Fleet for seamless 5G remote steering.
Tap any artifact link inside a trajectory step to open the formatted Artifact Preview bottom sheet without leaving the chat.
